The path forward

Commit in stages. Resolve the biggest unknowns first.

01
Before an offer is binding

Confirm measured area, active wiring, insurability and inspection terms. Get local agent feedback on resale range.

02
Before renovation spending

Written electrical and major-system quotes. Finalize permits and lock a scope that fits the reserve.

03
First year

Essential work first, then kitchen, baths and finishes. Keep permits, receipts and before/after records.

04
Year five or later

Refresh comps, recalculate selling and ownership costs, then set the exit price.

Verify before committing

What we still need to confirm.

  • Electrical: reported knob-and-tube wiring. Confirm active circuits, panel capacity, scope and insurability.
  • Size: 1,695 sq ft above grade plus an unfinished lower level, against the advertised 2,492. Reconcile before pricing.
  • Structure and systems: roof, foundation, moisture, boiler, plumbing, sewer.
  • Permits: confirm any historic review before exterior changes.
  • Margin is thin at the working case: $4K–$14K at $425K resale. Cost control is the project.
